title: Beyond the Stars
synopsis: A young engineer joins a dangerous mission beyond the solar system and discovers a signal that could change humanity forever.

title: Manila After Rain
synopsis: Two strangers cross paths during a rainy evening in Manila and find the courage to begin again.

synopsis: A radio operator receives a mysterious emergency broadcast and races to uncover its source before midnight.

synopsis: A simple beach trip becomes an unforgettable comedy of wrong turns, lost luggage, and lasting friendship.

synopsis: A street food vendor and a busker fall in love over one unforgettable night at Manila's busiest night market.
